import "timezone"
import "date"
import "array"
option location = timezone.fixed(offset: 7h)

day0 = today()
empty = array.from(rows: [{_time: 1970-01-01T00:00:00Z, _value: 0.0}])
  |> filter(fn: (r) => false)

pastStop = if v.timeRangeStop < day0 then v.timeRangeStop else day0
past = if v.timeRangeStart < day0 and pastStop > v.timeRangeStart then
  from(bucket: "solar_1d")
    |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: pastStop)
    |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "solar" and r._field == "value")
    |> filter(fn: (r) => r.device == "${device}")
    |> filter(fn: (r) => r.component == "house" and r.metric == "energy_today")
    |> aggregateWindow(every: 1d, fn: last, createEmpty: false, timeSrc: "_stop")
else
  empty

curStart = if v.timeRangeStart > day0 then v.timeRangeStart else day0
cur = if v.timeRangeStop > day0 and curStart < v.timeRangeStop then
  from(bucket: "solar_raw")
    |> range(start: curStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
    |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "solar" and r._field == "value")
    |> filter(fn: (r) => r.device == "${device}")
    |> filter(fn: (r) => r.component == "house" and r.metric == "energy_today")
    |> aggregateWindow(every: 1d, fn: last, createEmpty: false, timeSrc: "_stop")
else
  empty

union(tables: [past, cur])
  |> sum()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with _field: "House" }))

panels.title: Production vs Consumption (calendar month of Time Picker)
Production vs Consumption — ${__from:date:MMMM YYYY}
panels.description: Full calendar month of the Time Picker start. Bars = Production (PV + discharge − charge). Line = Consumption (house).

targets.query:
import "timezone"
import "date"
import "array"
option location = timezone.fixed(offset: 7h)

monthStart = date.truncate(t: v.timeRangeStart, unit: 1mo)
monthStop = date.add(d: 1mo, to: monthStart)
day0 = today()
empty = array.from(rows: [{_time: 1970-01-01T00:00:00Z, _value: 0.0}])
  |> filter(fn: (r) => false)

pastStop = if monthStop < day0 then monthStop else day0
past = if monthStart < day0 and pastStop > monthStart then
  from(bucket: "solar_1d")
    |> range(start: monthStart, stop: pastStop)
    |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "solar" and r._field == "value")
    |> filter(fn: (r) => r.device == "${device}")
    |> filter(fn: (r) =>
        (r.component == "pv" and r.metric == "energy_today") or
        (r.component == "battery" and r.metric == "discharge_today") or
        (r.component == "battery" and r.metric == "charge_today") or
        (r.component == "house" and r.metric == "energy_today")
    )
    |> map(fn: (r) => ({
        r with _field:
          if r.component == "house" then "house"
          else if r.metric == "charge_today" then "charge"
          else if r.metric == "discharge_today" then "discharge"
          else "pv"
    }))
    |> aggregateWindow(every: 1d, fn: last, createEmpty: true, timeSrc: "_start")
else
  empty

curStart = if monthStart > day0 then monthStart else day0
cur = if monthStop > day0 and curStart < monthStop then
  from(bucket: "solar_raw")
    |> range(start: curStart, stop: monthStop)
    |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "solar" and r._field == "value")
    |> filter(fn: (r) => r.device == "${device}")
    |> filter(fn: (r) =>
        (r.component == "pv" and r.metric == "energy_today") or
        (r.component == "battery" and r.metric == "discharge_today") or
        (r.component == "battery" and r.metric == "charge_today") or
        (r.component == "house" and r.metric == "energy_today")
    )
    |> map(fn: (r) => ({
        r with _field:
          if r.component == "house" then "house"
          else if r.metric == "charge_today" then "charge"
          else if r.metric == "discharge_today" then "discharge"
          else "pv"
    }))
    |> aggregateWindow(every: 1d, fn: last, createEmpty: true, timeSrc: "_start")
else
  empty

union(tables: [past, cur])
  |> filter(fn: (r) => exists r._time and r._time >= monthStart and r._time < monthStop)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with _value: if exists r._value then r._value else 0.0 }))
  |> group(columns: ["_field"])
  |> aggregateWindow(every: 1d, fn: last, createEmpty: true, timeSrc: "_start")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with _value: if exists r._value then r._value else 0.0 }))
  |> filter(fn: (r) => exists r._time and r._time >= monthStart and r._time < monthStop)
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> map(fn: (r) => {
      pv = if exists r.pv then float(v: r.pv) else 0.0
      dis = if exists r.discharge then float(v: r.discharge) else 0.0
      chg = if exists r.charge then float(v: r.charge) else 0.0
      house = if exists r.house then float(v: r.house) else 0.0
      d = date.monthDay(t: r._time)
      dayLabel = if d < 10 then "0" + string(v: d) else string(v: d)
      return {
        _time: v.timeRangeStart,
        Day: dayLabel,
        Production: pv + dis - chg,
        Consumption: house
      }
  })
  |> group()
  |> sort(columns: ["Day"])
  |> yield(name: "month")

panels.title: PV long-term (fixed ranges - not linked to Time Picker)
PV - Day (24h)
panels.description: Fixed: today (UTC+7). PV1+PV2 power (kW) as line. Ignores Time Picker.

targets.query:
import "timezone"
import "date"
option location = timezone.fixed(offset: 7h)

from(bucket: "solar_raw")
  |> range(start: today())
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "solar" and r._field == "value")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.device == "${device}")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => (r.component == "pv1" or r.component == "pv2") and r.metric == "power")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: 5m, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> group(columns: ["_time"])
  |> sum(column: "_value")
  |> group()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with _field: "PV", _value: r._value / 1000.0 }))
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_field", "_value"])
  |> yield(name: "day")

panels.title: PV - Week (Mon-Sun)
panels.description: Fixed: current week from Monday (UTC+7). Daily pv/energy_today. Ignores Time Picker.

targets.query:
import "timezone"
import "date"
option location = timezone.fixed(offset: 7h)

day0 = date.truncate(t: now(), unit: 1d)
wd = date.weekDay(t: day0)
sinceMon = if wd == 0 then 6 else wd - 1
weekStart = date.add(d: duration(v: "-" + string(v: sinceMon) + "d"), to: day0)
weekStop = date.add(d: 7d, to: weekStart)
todayStart = today()

past = from(bucket: "solar_1d")
  |> range(start: weekStart, stop: todayStart)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "solar" and r._field == "value")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.device == "${device}")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.component == "pv" and r.metric == "energy_today")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: 1d, fn: last, createEmpty: true, timeSrc: "_start")

cur = from(bucket: "solar_raw")
  |> range(start: todayStart, stop: weekStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "solar" and r._field == "value")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.device == "${device}")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.component == "pv" and r.metric == "energy_today")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: 1d, fn: last, createEmpty: true, timeSrc: "_start")

union(tables: [past, cur])
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with
      _field: "PV",
      _value: if exists r._value then r._value else 0.0
  }))
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_field", "_value"])
  |> group(columns: ["_field"])
  |> yield(name: "week")

option location = timezone.fixed(offset: 7h)

from(bucket: "solar_raw")
  |> range(start: today())

panels.title: House - Week (Mon-Sun)
panels.description: Fixed: current week from Monday (UTC+7). Daily house/energy_today. Ignores Time Picker.

targets.query:
import "timezone"
import "date"
option location = timezone.fixed(offset: 7h)

day0 = date.truncate(t: now(), unit: 1d)
wd = date.weekDay(t: day0)
sinceMon = if wd == 0 then 6 else wd - 1
weekStart = date.add(d: duration(v: "-" + string(v: sinceMon) + "d"), to: day0)
weekStop = date.add(d: 7d, to: weekStart)
todayStart = today()

past = from(bucket: "solar_1d")
  |> range(start: weekStart, stop: todayStart)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "solar" and r._field == "value")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.device == "${device}")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.component == "house" and r.metric == "energy_today")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: 1d, fn: last, createEmpty: true, timeSrc: "_start")

cur = from(bucket: "solar_raw")
  |> range(start: todayStart, stop: weekStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "solar" and r._field == "value")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.device == "${device}")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.component == "house" and r.metric == "energy_today")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: 1d, fn: last, createEmpty: true, timeSrc: "_start")

union(tables: [past, cur])
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with
      _field: "House",
      _value: if exists r._value then r._value else 0.0
  }))
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_field", "_value"])
  |> group(columns: ["_field"])
  |> yield(name: "week")
